get.summary: fpp-failover status: role, state, peer health, player position, heard players, content pipeline and recent events
get.description: Served at /api/plugin-apis/failover. The action may be omitted or given as ?action=status. The action is a query parameter rather than a path segment because FPP 10.0 to 10.1.x do not dispatch subpaths of a plugin route that was loaded at runtime; FPP 10.2 fixed that, so /api/plugin-apis/failover/status also works there.

post.description: Served at /api/plugin-apis/failover?action=<action>, with an optional JSON body. Player actions (takeover, yield, failback, resume) need the node to be a primary or backup; content actions (promoteContent, checkContent, rollbackContent) need a backup or remote. requestHandoff is node-to-node and returns {accepted, playlist, nextIndex, endsInMs}. Bodies: takeover {"graceful": true|false, "manual": true}; yield {"manual": true} pins a primary in standby until fail-back; rollbackContent {"snapshot": "<id>|latest", "target": "local|primary|both"}, and rolling back the primary snapshots its current content first.

graceful.description: takeover: wait for the peer's current item to end (true) or stop it now (false)

manual.description: takeover/yield: pin a primary in standby until fail-back

200.description: Action queued, or for requestHandoff the handoff plan

409.description: Wrong role for this action, or a content job is already running
